actual_scope: Prove a quantitative lower singular-value margin for the Gaussian tensor Stein boundary minor and inverse displacement, and prove that Cp-bit entry or one-factor coefficient rounding cannot reduce the ordinary generator requirement in an explicit source-compatible sublinear-axis regime.
scope_change_reason: This is the second-wave continuation of the exact normalized-core displacement audit. Exact rank alone did not establish a usable finite-precision obstruction. The present task closes that specific approximation implication rather than claiming a complete analytic_recovery discharge.

stop_rule: Stop after explicit all-size norm/precision bounds, bounded exact rational certificates and negative controls, and source/provenance review. Stop earlier if the margin costs Theta(p) or more guard bits in the stated actual-source regime. Do not infer runtime impossibility or a new kappa.
